scope: Exploratory control study specified after Experiment 08 and before computing this experiment. Not a confirmatory preregistration or biological validation.
models_and_cases: Use all 21 frozen Experiment 07 CNNs and the exact twelve Experiment 08 cases. Verify hashes, saved predictions and input identities. No new fitting, case selection, threshold tuning or learning-test scoring.
target: Keep Experiment 08 true-label logit margin (2*y-1)*(logit_M-logit_B) fixed for each case, including incorrect predictions.

real_references.selection: numpy default_rng; process labels 0 then 1, choose without replacement from fit-partition positions, sort positions within class. Only the 318 fit rows are eligible. Same four references for every evaluation case and model. Retain label, sample ID, fit position and original row index.
real_references.limits: Two references per class define a small deliberately balanced collection, not a representative estimate of the empirical fitting distribution or a claim that either class is absence of disease.

reuse: Reuse verified median/minimum IG vectors and numerical diagnostics from Experiment 08; compute four real-reference IG vectors per model/case. No attribution averaging or expected-gradients claim.

integrated_gradients.refinement: Reuse Experiment 08 helper: double quadrature until tolerance met or cap. Retain all failures and report them; no setting search after inspection.

model_free_ranking: Absolute input-minus-reference difference in common fit-minmax feature space; independent of CNN weights, layouts and evaluation labels. Not an attribution or causal ground truth.

replacement.subsets: For each evaluation position, default_rng(seed + position) chooses 100 feature subsets without replacement within each subset. The same subsets serve all six references and all models. This k=5 bank differs from Experiment 08, which consumed RNG draws for k=1 and k=3 first.
replacement.ties: Original feature index breaks ranking ties. Constant ranking vectors are ineligible. Primary outcome ties use abs(a-b) <= 1e-6*max(1,abs(a),abs(b)).
replacement.primary: Absolute fixed-target score change after replacing five selected features by that reference. Compare magnitude-IG with distance within the same model/case/reference; report IG win/tie/loss and random-percentile differences. Do not compare absolute logit scales across models as quality measures.
replacement.secondary: Retain signed score drops and signed-IG-support ranking. Directional advantage over distance is not an apples-to-apples attribution validation because distance has no target sign.
replacement.percentile: Midrank among absolute random score changes for the primary metric; signed random score changes for the secondary. Descriptive, not p-values. Keep raw random drops and selected indices.

agreement: Signed and absolute Spearman and absolute top-5 Jaccard in original feature order; undefined constant-vector statistics remain null.
reference_sensitivity: Compare all six pairs among the four real references per model/case. Separate reference pairs sharing a class from cross-class pairs. Also compare each real reference with the median. Different references define different contrasts; disagreement alone is not method failure.
seed_stability: For each of the six references separately, compare all CNN-seed pairs within layout and all layout-seed pairs within method/CNN seed. No pooling of different references inside a pair.
reporting: Report each real reference and aggregate its four-reference means; stratify real-reference replacement by same versus opposite class relative to the case. Keep all models/cases. Repeated runs, reference pairs and cases are dependent; no significance or general superiority claim. Illustrations use the first selected evaluation case and first SOM/CNN seeds.
limits: Only four chosen reference records and twelve reused morphology cases
Real endpoints do not guarantee on-distribution IG paths or hybrid replacement inputs
Large absolute score changes are intervention sensitivity, not automatically faithful explanations
No new tabular baseline, genomic analysis, group intervention, clinical claim or novelty claim
